header: Ticks and crosses for one price
subheader: What is included and what is not
lead: One list in one to four columns. It compares nothing and only shows what one price covers.
note: Conditions go in the note, so each row stays short.

items.title: Each row has a labelled mark
items.text: A screen reader can’t announce a colour, so each mark has a name.

items.title: A row can end in a value
items.text: For a quantity, a limit or a rate.

items.title: A row can add a note line
items.text: It sits below the label, not next to it.

items.title: Rows read down a column, then across
items.text: The way a printed checklist is read.

items.title: Excluded rows stay in place
items.text: Removing them would hide what the price leaves out.

items.title: Calculated totals
items.text: The list states what is covered and adds nothing up.
